shared_elements: human figure rendered in relief on stone
circular/disc motifs (rosettes in A, concentric circles in B)
justification: The only real overlap is that both surfaces carry human figural imagery in relief and both include round disc motifs (a rosette band in A, concentric circle marks on B), which are about as generic as iconography gets. A shows a horizontal narrative procession of striding profile figures with staffs and offerings leading a large naturalistic camel between ornamental borders, whereas B is a single massive frontal figure whose body is covered with isolated schematic curvilinear and circular signs and no narrative or animal content at all.
